purpose: Parameterized PPG LED average-power calculator (Day 12 support). Implements exactly the formula already frozen in results/reference_power_budget_day11_part2.json's wrist_ppg.led_contribution block. Does NOT choose a final LED count/current/wavelength schedule.

current_repository_state.note: Matches results/reference_power_budget_day11_part2.json exactly - none of these 5 inputs are frozen yet. This support artifact does not resolve them; it only confirms the formula computes correctly once they are.

illustrative_example_NOT_CANONICAL.label: HYPOTHETICAL_INPUT_DEMONSTRATION_ONLY - these numbers are not a proposal, selection, or estimate for this project's actual LED stack
illustrative_example_NOT_CANONICAL.purpose_of_example: demonstrates the calculator is dimensionally correct and produces a sane order-of-magnitude result (low-duty-cycle pulsed PPG LEDs typically average well under their peak power) - not an engineering recommendation

unit_safety.current_unit: mA (not uA - inconsistent with the AFE current fields elsewhere which use uA; caller must convert)
unit_safety.duty_factor_range_check: raises ValueError if t_pulse*f_pulse falls outside [0,1] - catches a common ms/seconds or Hz/kHz unit-mixing mistake

how_claude_should_use_this: Once LED count/current/forward-voltage/pulse-width/pulse-rate are frozen (from datasheet + selected optical sequencing), call compute_led_power() with those values. Do not hand-compute this arithmetic separately - reuse this function so the formula stays in exactly one place.
